Colored markdown for Claude Code replies: **bold**, *italic*, ~~struck~~, \`inline code\`, a [link](https://github.com/OG-Matcha/tessera) and a bare URL https://github.com/OG-Matcha/tessera/issues, both clickable, numbers like 99.9% and 250ms, paths like ~/src/app.ts.

| Command | Does |
|---------|------|
| \`/tessera\` | This screen |
| \`/tessera theme <name>\` | Switch theme on the spot |
| \`/tessera copy\` | Copy the last reply, or \`copy code\` for its last code block |
| \`/config\` | Edit any option |

> ${themes.length} themes ship with it. \`mono\` uses no color, only bold and dim.

\`\`\`bash
/tessera theme nord
/tessera theme github-light
\`\`\`

3. Plain

> [!TIP]

### Alerts

> [!IMPORTANT]
> After updating the plugin, open sessions need \`/reload\`.

> [!WARNING]
> Terminals that copy on select (Warp) can turn a click on a copy button into a selection. Use the keyboard shortcut.

- [x] Parse the reply

export type Voice = 'zh-Hant' | 'zh-Hans' | 'ja' | 'ko' | 'en'

const VOICE_NAMES: Record<Voice, string> = {
  'zh-Hant': 'Traditional Chinese (繁體中文)',
  'zh-Hans': 'Simplified Chinese (简体中文)',
  ja: 'Japanese (日本語)',
  ko: 'Korean (한국어)',
  en: 'English',
}

// The person's own words: a prompt less what they pasted or quoted (code, logs, chat lines, links, paths).
export function ownWords(prompt: string): string {
  return prompt
    .replace(/```[\s\S]*?(```|$)/g, ' ')
    .replace(/"""[\s\S]*?("""|$)/g, ' ')
    .replace(/`[^`\n]*`/g, ' ')
    .replace(/\[(Pasted text|Image)[^\]]*\]/g, ' ')
    .replace(/https?:\/\/\S+/g, ' ')
    .replace(/(?:[A-Za-z]:)?[\\/][^\s，。、]+/g, ' ')
    .split('\n')
    .filter(line => {
      const l = line.trim()
      if (l.startsWith('>')) return false
      if (/^\[?\d{1,2}:\d{2}(:\d{2})?\]?\s/.test(l)) return false
      if (/^(at |\s*File "|Traceback|Error:|\w+Error\b|WARN|INFO|DEBUG|\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}[ T])/.test(l)) return false
      const symbols = (l.match(/[{}[\]();=<>|\\/$#@*_]/g) ?? []).length
      return symbols < l.length * 0.15
    })
    .join('\n')
}

const TRAD = /[們這個說時會為發對沒過還進動開關問題實現應該讓從麼與後體點樣門裡請將當覺樣頁]/g
const SIMP = /[们这个说时会为发对没过还进动开关问题实现应该让从么与后体点样门里请将当觉页]/g

export function voiceOf(prompt: string): Voice | undefined {
  const own = ownWords(prompt)
  const han = (own.match(/\p{Script=Han}/gu) ?? []).length
  const kana = (own.match(/[\p{Script=Hiragana}\p{Script=Katakana}]/gu) ?? []).length
  const hangul = (own.match(/\p{Script=Hangul}/gu) ?? []).length
  const latinWords = (own.match(/[A-Za-z]{2,}/g) ?? []).length
  const cjk = han + kana + hangul
  if (cjk < 2 && latinWords < 3) return undefined
  if (cjk >= latinWords) {
    if (hangul > 0 && hangul >= kana) return 'ko'
    if (kana > 0) return 'ja'
    return (own.match(SIMP) ?? []).length > (own.match(TRAD) ?? []).length ? 'zh-Hans' : 'zh-Hant'
  }
  return 'en'
}

export const replyNote = (voice: Voice) =>
  `The person writes in ${VOICE_NAMES[voice]}. Reply in ${VOICE_NAMES[voice]}, even when the pasted logs, code or documents are in another language; keep code, commands, identifiers and quoted text as they are.`

{

  "description": "One mod for Claude Code, Windows and CJK first: pasted-image and text previews in any terminal, themed replies with CJK-correct tables and charts, unfinished tasks carried into the next session, and guards for multi-agent runs and Traditional Chinese writing",
  "author": {
    "name": "OG-Matcha",
    "url": "https://github.com/OG-Matcha"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/OG-Matcha/tessera",
  "repository": "https://github.com/OG-Matcha/tessera",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "claude-code",
    "windows",
    "zh-tw",
    "images",
    "theme",
    "markdown",
    "mermaid",
    "workflow"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "enabled": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Enabled",
      "description": "Draw replies with this mod. Off falls back to Claude Code's own renderer.",
      "default": true
    },
    "pastePreview": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Paste previews",
      "description": "Pasted images as thumbnails and pasted text the editor collapses to [Pasted text #n] as its first lines, above the prompt. Off: no polling of the prompt box at all.",
      "default": true
    },
    "language": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Language",
      "description": "Language of tessera's own words (buttons, toasts, /tessera). auto follows Claude Code's language setting, then LC_ALL / LANG, then the system locale; any Chinese reads Traditional Chinese.",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "en",
        "zh-TW"
      ]
    },
    "replyLanguage": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Reply in my language",
      "description": "auto: when your own words (not pasted code, logs, quotes or chat lines) are Chinese, Japanese or Korean, ask Claude to reply in that language. off: leave replies alone.",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "imageMode": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Image previews",
      "description": "How pasted images preview above the prompt. auto: real pixels in terminals with kitty graphics (kitty, Ghostty), cell art everywhere else. pixels: always real pixels. cells: always cell art.",
      "default": "auto",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "pixels",
        "cells"
      ]
    },
    "thumbnailSize": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Preview size",
      "description": "Largest preview box: small (28x8 cells), medium (40x12), large (64x20).",
      "default": "medium",
      "options": [
        "small",
        "medium",
        "large"
      ]
    },
    "theme": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Theme",
      "description": "Base palette, from popular MIT-licensed themes. Light variants: catppuccin-latte, gruvbox-light, rose-pine-dawn, github-light, solarized-light. mono uses bold and dim only.",
      "default": "catppuccin-mocha",
      "options": [
        "catppuccin-mocha",
        "catppuccin-latte",
        "dracula",
        "nord",
        "tokyo-night",
        "gruvbox-dark",
        "gruvbox-light",
        "rose-pine",
        "rose-pine-dawn",
        "everforest",
        "github-dark",
        "github-light",
        "one-dark",
        "solarized-dark",
        "solarized-light",
        "mono"
      ]
    },
    "headingStyle": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Heading style",
      "description": "Terminals have one font size, so headings get weight instead: banner (a box around H1, a heavy rule under H2), bold, underline, or uppercase H1.",
      "default": "banner",
      "options": [
        "bold",
        "underline",
        "uppercase",
        "banner"
      ]
    },
    "tableStyle": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Table style",
      "description": "box: every cell boxed, with a double line under the header. rules: a rule under the header and between rows. grid: heavier header rule, wider gaps. minimal: header rule only.",
      "default": "box",
      "options": [
        "box",
        "rules",
        "grid",
        "minimal"
      ]
    },
    "promptStyle": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Your prompt style",
      "description": "How the prompts you type draw in the transcript. bubble: a rounded box in the accent color. bar: an accent bar on the left. chevron: a bold accent › before the text. off: Claude Code's own look.",
      "default": "bubble",
      "options": [
        "bubble",
        "bar",
        "chevron",
        "off"
      ]
    },

      "type": "string",
      "title": "Tool row style",

      "default": "chat",
      "options": [
        "chat",
        "tree-dim",
        "tree-bold",
        "classic"
      ]
    },
    "taskStyle": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Task list style",

      "default": "checks",
      "options": [
        "checks",
        "ticks",
        "box",
        "progress"
      ]

    "rtl": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Right-to-left terminal",

        "iterm",
        "ghostty",
        "wezterm",
        "vscode",
        "alacritty",
        "windows-terminal",
        "gnome",
        "konsole",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "highlightNumbers": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Highlight numbers",
      "description": "Color versions, IDs, counts and durations in prose and tables.",
      "default": true
    },
    "highlightPaths": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Highlight paths",
      "description": "Color file paths like ~/src/app.ts or /var/log.",
      "default": true
    },
    "accentColor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Accent",
      "description": "Color for the reply bullet, H3+ headings and quote bars. Hex (#a6e3a1), rgb(166,227,161), ansi256(114) or a name (green). Empty uses the theme.",

    "headingColor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Heading",

      "default": ""

      "default": ""

    "tableRuleColor": {

      "default": ""
    },
    "numberColor": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Numbers",
      "description": "Color for versions, IDs and counts. Hex (#a6e3a1), rgb(166,227,161), ansi256(114) or a name (green). Empty uses the theme.",
      "default": ""

    "pathColor": {

      "title": "Paths",

    "codeCommandColor": {
